items.html: But certainly in another aspect they are equal, and it is that in the word "Israel," there is still in the Shema of the sacrifices no more in ZA than there is in the Shema of the evening. But nevertheless, the power of the Shema of the sacrifices is greater, for it drew two levels together, unlike the Shema of the evening, which drew only one level. And therefore, since the Shema of the sacrifices has this advantage over the Shema of the evening, therefore it has the power to draw from a more excellent level, namely from the interiority of Arich Anpin. And afterwards, in the word "Echad," the encircling ones of the Katnut of Aba enter with the inner ones of the VAK of the Gadlut of Ima.
